title: Sign-out skips the unsaved-changes guard and drops pending line saves
failure_scenario: A manager edits a PO, inventory item or sell order (dirty, guard registered) and clicks the sidebar sign-out icon next to their name. The edits are discarded with no prompt. In Review mode, ticking a line and signing out within the 400 ms debounce sends that tick without a session, and it is lost silently: the count never reaches the server.
